claim: ARENA presents a five-step TES assessment covering process fit, alternatives, designs and vendors, electrical infrastructure, and commercial evaluation.
source_or_reference: ARENA, Thermal energy storage for industrial process heat A practical guide, landing-page report extract. https://arena.gov.au/knowledge-bank/thermal-energy-storage-for-industrial-process-heat-a-practical-guide/
notes: Supports assessment method, not this plant's feasibility or a specific vendor. The landing-page extract, rather than the full report, was inspected.

claim: Rondo reports that a 100 MWh refractory-brick heat battery entered daily operation delivering industrial heat and steam in California.
source_or_reference: Rondo Energy, Rondo Powers Up World's Largest Industrial Heat Battery. https://www.rondo.com/news-press/rondo-powers-up-worlds-largest-industrial-heat-battery
notes: Reported operation goes beyond an announced pipeline. Vendor-reported performance is not independent assurance; no global adoption rate, food-plant qualification or local price follows.

claim: ARENA describes staged funding for Yarwun TES, with engineering/design work preceding conditional deployment support.
source_or_reference: ARENA, Demonstrating a new pathway for electrifying industrial heat at scale. https://arena.gov.au/news/demonstrating-a-new-pathway-for-electrifying-industrial-heat-at-scale/
notes: Current evidence of staged evaluation and integration risk. Planned refinery deployment is not an operating result, and Australian funding does not establish subsidy eligibility for the hypothetical US plant.
